'''Vanter Raffin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ession]]. He served as the chief officer for [[Pakkerd Light Transport]]. He was a supporter of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and was described by the Warlord as someone who's nervous and complains too much. He was set to retire sometime around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] and planned to live in a cottage and write his memoirs.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vanter Raffin was a character created by author [[Aaron Allston]] for his novel ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]'', the fifth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] published in [[1998]].<ref name="WS" />

In ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]], Raffin's title was labeled as chief of security for the government of Ession,<ref name="TCSWE" /> while ''X-Wing: Wraith Squadron'' presented him as the chief officer for Pakkerd Light Transport, and [[Hola Paskalian]] as his security director.<ref name="WS" />
